label: Ontario fiscal update; Canada-EU summit
why: Ontario updates its deficit forecast as the prime minister opens a two-day summit with EU leaders in Montreal.

label: New U.S. tariffs take effect

label: U.S. October jobs report

label: Bank of Canada and Fed rate decisions
